Tessa — thanks for the quick organization and the draft timelines. The 08/27 consolidated delivery sounds great and will fit our review window. A couple clarifying items:
- For encryption at rest, can you confirm the KMS provider (cloud-managed KMS vs. customer-managed HSM) and where key wrapping occurs? If that's in the workbook, please highlight it in the evidence column and attach the KMS policy.
- For monitoring logs retention: we require at least 180 days for security logs for this vendor tier. Can you confirm retention windows and call out any logs that are shorter and why?

If those two things are highlighted in the consolidated delivery on 08/27, we should be set for the 09/01 sync. Appreciate the help.

— Joel Park
Acme Vendor Risk Management
